hero.title.2: I like taking an idea all the way to the finish.

hero.title.3: Building is how I learn best.

sobre.texto.1: I'm in the second semester of Multiplatform Software Development at Fatec Jacareí. Right now, I'm looking for my first professional opportunity as a developer.
sobre.texto.2: My experience comes from personal and academic projects, as well as hackathons. I mainly work with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL, following development from the interface through to the database.
sobre.texto.3: I learn best when I have a real problem to solve. I enjoy investigating bugs, organizing ideas and sharing what I learn with the people building alongside me.
info.formacao.texto: Fatec Jacareí · Multiplatform Software Development · second semester.
info.foco.texto: I'm deepening my full-stack knowledge while beginning to explore cybersecurity and artificial intelligence.
info.hobbies.texto: I play drums, watch anime — especially Tokyo Ghoul — and play Dead by Daylight, Counter-Strike and Valorant. I'm also an altar server at my local parish and enjoy cars and sport motorcycles.
